title: Every priest is small; Christ is the great priest
english: Every priest among men is small in comparison to him: “You are a priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek” (Psalm 110:4). Christ is the great priest.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is contrasting the Levitical priests, who are small among men, with Christ, who is the great priest according to the order of Melchizedek.

title: The Anointing of Christ and Christians
english: Into him the oil of chrism has been poured. The anointing of the Spirit. Christians from Christ.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is describing the greatness of Christ as the great priest, and now explains how the anointing oil was poured into him and how Christians receive their name from Christ.

title: The perfect one loves above the flesh
english: He will not be contaminated by father or mother (Leviticus 21:11). The perfect one loves above the flesh.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the high priest's purity rules from Leviticus 21, applying them spiritually to the Christian who is anointed.

title: The high priest's marriage as the Church's chastity
english: Whoever does not hate father… Let him take a virgin wife from his own people (Leviticus 21:13-14). The Church is a chaste virgin for Christ. Not a widow of heresies.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the high priest's marriage rules from Leviticus 21, applying them spiritually to Christ and the Church.

title: The unblemished offerer and Christ's purity
english: No one who has a blemish will offer. The blemishes are vices. Christ is unblemished.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical rule about priestly blemishes to the moral life, saying that no one with a blemish may offer, and then identifies Christ as the one without blemish.

title: Eating holy things in a holy place
english: They will eat the holy things in a holy place (Leviticus 10:13). Do not profane the mysteries. Fear of discipline.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the rules for the priests who eat the holy offerings, applying them to the soul's approach to spiritual mysteries.

title: God alone sanctifies
english: I am the Lord who sanctifies them (Leviticus 22:16). Holiness comes from God. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his homily on the holiness required of those who eat holy things, quoting the divine declaration that God himself is the sanctifier.
